title: Battle of Elba
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Elba", at revision 1370439896, opens: "The naval Battle of Elba was a naval battle which took place on 28 August 1652 during the First Anglo-Dutch War, between a Dutch squadron under Johan van Galen and an English squadron under Captain Richard Badiley." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1814482, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1652 naval battle during First Anglo-Dutch war". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
